subject: Lumina: request to add surge-indexed GPUs + amendment next steps
messages:
From: Aaron Park <aaron@lumina.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha@lumina.ai>; procurement@lumina.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: We need to reopen GPU commit — usage spike and short-term surge

Hi Tessa,

Hope you had a good weekend. We shipped a new personalization feature last month and have already seen a sustained 40% increase in token throughput for our inference pipelines. That spike is starting to burn through the commit we signed for Q4 and were worried about throttling or higher overage exposure.

Attached is our utilization export for Q3 (lumina-util-report-2027Q3.csv) that shows the tail of the growth. Can Redwood propose a short-term top-up strategy we can attach to the current contract? Ideally something that indexes to actual utilization (wed prefer burst/elastic top-up vs a long-term tranche). Samantha from engineering is looped in; procurement is on cc for timing/paperwork.

Key asks:
- Can we add GPUs for an 8–12 week surge window tied to observed utilization?
- What pricing/discount structure applies for a short tranche add-on vs an annual commit?
- Can you help size the tranche so we avoid sudden throttling?

Thanks,
Aaron
Aaron Park
Head of ML Platforms | Lumina Health
attachments: lumina-util-report-2027Q3.csv
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Park <aaron@lumina.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: We need to reopen GPU commit — usage spike and short-term surge

Hi Aaron,

Thanks for the report and the clear asks. This is exactly the kind of usage signal our Optimize tooling flags. Quick notes before we sync:

- We can offer a surge-indexed addendum that provisions a reserve tranche for 8/12 weeks and automatically scales down when prefix/KV cache usage normalizes.
- Pricing: short-duration tranche rates are higher than annual commits but we can apply a partial-prorated credit toward your next renewal if this converts to a longer commit.
- Sizing: preliminary read suggests a +25% GPU buffer to avoid throttling, but I want to validate with Rishi on batching/quantization headroom.

Vanessa will draft a proposal and an amendment; Dev, can you pull expected sustained tokens/sec by model from the telemetry and confirm safe burst sizing?

I'd like to propose a quick 30-min call Wed 03 Nov 10:00 PT to align on sizing and timeline. If that works for you, Ill send a calendar invite.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198
attachments: none
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Aaron Park <aaron@lumina.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: We need to reopen GPU commit — usage spike and short-term surge

Hi all,

Quick technical assessment after a fast look at the CSV Aaron shared:
- Median seq len is unchanged but tail latency is driven by 10% of requests that are 2–3x longer.
- We have two levers that reduce required GPUs for parity: better batching heuristics for the long-tail and enabling 8-bit quantization for one of your large variants.

If Lumina is comfortable enabling quantization on non-sensitive models, we could get about 18–22% effective GPU reduction. Combined with continuous batching tweaks, Id revise Tessas buffer suggestion to +10–15% GPUs for the surge window. That should be a cheaper top-up than +25%.

I can run a quick simulated throughput pass with your telemetry if you share the tokens/sec by model and a sample of the long-tail request profiles (anonymized).

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Park <aaron@lumina.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, procurement@lumina.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: We need to reopen GPU commit — usage spike and short-term surge

Aaron / Samantha / Procurement team,

Thanks for the details. Draft attached: redwood-proposal-v2.pdf and amendment-draft.docx. Summary below:

Proposal highlights:
- Surge-indexed addendum: +12 GPU NVidia-A100 equivalent reserve for up to 12 weeks, auto-scale by telemetry, with a floor of 4 GPUs.
- Pricing: 6-week and 12-week options. 12-week option priced at $X, with a 20% credit toward renewal if Lumina converts the top-up to annual within 90 days.
- Tech operations: Rishi will run a simulated pass; wed enable continuous batching improvements during the surge window and can advise on safe quantization candidates.
- Paperwork & timing: If Lumina signs the addendum by Nov 10 we can start provisioning by Nov 15. DocuSign link included in the Drive doc.

Attachments: redwood-proposal-v2.pdf (pricing & SLOs), amendment-draft.docx (legal addendum).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Rishi runs throughput sim and confirms revised sizing (+10–15%).
2) Aaron confirms whether youre comfortable with quantization on non-PHI models.
3) Procurement to confirm internal approvals & preferred DocuSign signer.

Ill update the HubSpot deal after you confirm.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-proposal-v2.pdf; amendment-draft.docx
From: Aaron Park <aaron@lumina.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, procurement@lumina.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: We need to reopen GPU commit — usage spike and short-term surge

Thanks everyone — this plan looks reasonable. A few quick answers:
- We are okay enabling quantization for non-PHI models; Samantha will send an anonymized sample of long-tail requests by EOD.
- Procurement confirmed internal routing; they want the 12-week option with the renewal credit.
- Please proceed with Rishis simulation and let us know final recommended tranche.

Vanessa, can you attach the DocuSign-ready amendment and Ill get it routed to our CFO this week? Wed like provisioning to begin no later than Nov 15. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/LUM-2027-EXP-042

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Aaron
Aaron Park
Head of ML Platforms | Lumina Health
